title: Codwen unified tracker schema
description: One row shape for every plan/tracker on this machine. A repo keeps its native file (CSV or Markdown) and declares how to read it in .agentq/trackers.json; this schema is the superset every reader agrees on, and the status enum is the one vocabulary. No repo is forced to migrate its file - the mapping is the single source of truth for how it is read.

status.description: Canonical status. Every repo maps its own tokens onto this set (see trackerFile.status.map); a token with no mapping is a drift finding, never silently accepted.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within one tracker. The shape is declared per tracker (trackerFile.idPattern); the unified contract only requires uniqueness and a declared shape.

trackerItem.description: One planned unit of work. The first six fields are the common core every tracker in the fleet already carries in some spelling; the rest are optional and repo-specific.

group.description: The slice / stage / category the item sits in (vitals: slice S<nn>, agentq: stage, codai: area, brivio: epic). Optional but recommended - it is what turns a flat list into a plan.

evidence.description: How the item is proven done - the acceptance criterion or the verification note (vitals: verification, agentq: acceptance, codai: gate+evidence). A done item with no evidence is a drift finding.

owner.description: Agent, person, or lane that owns the item.

paths.description: Path claims (globs) the item touches - the input to the conflict-forecast between two ready items.

deps.description: Ids this item depends on. 'next' must never hand out an item with an open dependency.

commit.description: Short sha the item landed on, when known.

columnMap.description: Maps this schema's field names to the physical column names of one tracker file. A field absent from the map is not present in that file.

id.description: Tracker id, unique within the repo.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root.

idPattern.description: Regex every id must match, and that must appear in no other tracker's ids.

map.description: Native token -> canonical status. A native token not in the map is a drift finding.

column.description: Column holding the status, when it differs from columns.status.

index.description: Optional overrides for how the tracker is rendered in an index (and the Vitals page).

kind.description: plan | audit | research | product - what the tracker is for.

trackerRegistry.description: The per-repo .agentq/trackers.json. This is the single source of truth for how a repo's trackers are found and read; it is committed to git so it survives every machine, slot and clone.

repo.description: Folder name of the repo root; must match the git worktree common dir's parent.

narrative.description: Narrative companions (e.g. docs/TRACKER.md). Read for drift only: every id referenced there must exist in a tracker.

repoIndex.description: One repo as the cross-repo scan sees it.

drift.description: Every drift finding for this repo: unmapped status, duplicate id, dangling reference, dangling narrative id.

trackerIndex.description: The merged cross-repo index, written to the agentq state dir and consumed by 'agentq tracker' and the Vitals Tracking page. This - not any single file - is what a client reads for fleet-wide status.
